description: This file manages the recovery process for delivery queue entries, including retry logic, backoff calculations, error handling, and moving failed entries to a failed state. It is part of an outbound delivery system in a messaging infrastructure.

classes.name: RecoveryLogger
classes.description: Interface for logging recovery process events with methods info, warn, and error.

methods.name: createEmptyRecoverySummary
methods.description: Creates an initial recovery summary object with zeroed counters.

methods.name: buildRecoveryDeliverParams
methods.description: Constructs delivery parameters for retrying a queued delivery entry.

methods.name: moveEntryToFailedWithLogging
methods.description: Moves a delivery entry to the failed state with error logging.

methods.name: deferRemainingEntriesForBudget
methods.description: Defers remaining delivery entries when recovery time budget is exceeded.

methods.name: computeBackoffMs
methods.description: Calculates backoff delay in milliseconds based on retry count.

methods.name: isEntryEligibleForRecoveryRetry
methods.description: Determines if a delivery entry is eligible for retry based on backoff and attempt timestamps.

methods.name: isPermanentDeliveryError
methods.description: Checks if an error message matches patterns indicating a permanent delivery failure.

methods.name: recoverPendingDeliveries
methods.description: Main function to scan, retry, and manage pending delivery queue entries during startup.
